title.zh: 将西内格罗斯省希马迈兰市镇卡拉萨社区学校的名称变更为Don Jose T. Ramos纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Calasa Community School in the Municipality of Himamaylan, Province of Negros Occidental, to Don Jose T. Ramos Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Calasa Community School in the Municipality of Himamaylan, Province of Negros Occidental, to Don Jose T. Ramos Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Calasa Community School tại Thị trấn Himamaylan, Tỉnh Negros Occidental thành Don Jose T. Ramos Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Calasa Community School ในเทศบาล Himamaylan, จังหวัด Negros Occidental เป็น Don Jose T. Ramos Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Calasa Community School di Kotamadya Himamaylan, Provinsi Negros Occidental menjadi Don Jose T. Ramos Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Calasa Community School di Perbandaran Himamaylan, Wilayah Negros Occidental menjadi Don Jose T. Ramos Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4300_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Calasa Community School in the Municipality of Himamaylan, Province of Negros Occidental, is hereby changed to Don Jose T. Ramos Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
